================ E-graph declaration
egraph Optimizer { rule fuse : map(f, map(g, x)) => map(compose(f, g), x)

cost_fn cost(node: i64) -> f64 {
    Seq(a, b) => a + b,
}

extract best : minimize(cost)
}
